# Uptime

`c.Uptime` calls the API's Uptime group. Get the uptime of target hosts.

## Methods

| Method                       | Returns                              | Permission    | Description                 |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------- | --------------------------- |
| [`Get(ctx, hostname)`](#get) | `*Response[Collection[UptimeEntry]]` | `uptime:read` | Get the uptime of the host. |

### Get

```go
func (s *UptimeService) Get(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
) (*Response[Collection[UptimeEntry]], error)
```

Get the uptime of the host.

Reads how long the host has run since it booted: /proc/uptime on Linux, and the
boot time that sysctl gives on macOS. The uptime is in days, hours and minutes,
and in seconds.

It sends `GET /api/node/{hostname}/uptime`, and needs the permission
`uptime:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

A host up for a day, two hours and five minutes, `go run uptime.go get`:

```go
resp, err := c.Uptime.Get(ctx, target)
```
